---
title: Sticky Notes — Examples
format: html
filters:
  - sticky-notes
---

## Default (yellow, inline)

Here is some surrounding text.

::: {.sticky}
A default sticky note.
:::

And the text continues.

## Named color

::: {.sticky color="pink"}
A pink one.
:::

## Hex color

::: {.sticky color="#c8e6c9"}
Custom hex green background.
:::

## Sized inline

::: {.sticky width="14em"}
Constrained to 14em wide.
:::

## Tilted inline

::: {.sticky tilt="-3"}
Tilted three degrees counter-clockwise.
:::

## Positioned

::: {.sticky top="180px" left="60%" width="14em" tilt="4"}
Positioned, sized, and tilted. Anchored to the page body.
:::

## Overlapping (source-order stacking)

::: {.sticky top="500px" left="10%" color="pink" width="12em"}
First (pink), should be under.
:::

::: {.sticky top="540px" left="14%" color="#ffd54f" width="12em" tilt="-5"}
Second (amber, tilted), should cover the pink one.
:::

## Unknown color (expect warning)

::: {.sticky color="taupe"}
Should fall back to yellow with a warning at render time.
:::

## Block content inside a sticky

::: {.sticky color="pink" width="20em"}
A sticky with **rich** content:

- a list item
- another item

```r
1 + 1
```
:::

## Square (post-it shape)

::: {.sticky .square}
Square!
:::

::: {.sticky .square color="pink"}
Pink square.
:::

::: {.sticky .square color="#c8e6c9" tilt="-4" top="900px" left="50%"}
Positioned square, tilted.
:::

## Trailing text

Some text after all the stickies so the page has scrollable content.

```{=html}
<div style="height: 600px;"></div>
```
